'''Govinda Bhaṭṭathiri''' ({{circa}} 1237–1295),<ref>{{cite book|last=K.V. Sarma|title=[[A History of the Kerala School of Hindu Astronomy]]|publisher=V.V.R. Institute|location=Hoshiarpur|date=1972}} (p.47)</ref><ref name="Joseph">{{cite book|last=George Gheverghese Joseph|title=[[A Passage to Infinity|A passage to infinity : Medieval Indian mathematics from Kerala and its impact]]|publisher=Sage Publications India Pvt. Ltd. |date=2009|chapter=2|isbn=978-81-321-0168-0}} (p.15)</ref> also known as '''Govinda Bhattathiri of Thalakkulam''' was an Indian [[astrologer]] and [[astronomer]] who flourished in [[Kerala]] during the thirteenth century [[Common Era|CE]].

Govinda Bhaṭṭatiri was born in the [[Nambudiri]] family known by the name Thalakkulathur in the  village of [[Alathiyur, Malappuram|Alathiyur]], [[Tirur]] in Kerala. He was traditionally considered to be the progenitor of the Pazhur [[Kaniyar]] family of astrologers. He is an important figure in the Kerala astrological traditions.<ref name="Joseph"/><ref name="Sankunny">{{cite book|last=Kottarathil Sankunni|title=Eithihyamaala|publisher=Kottarathil Sankunni Memorial Committee|location=Kottayam|date=1990|language=ml}} (pp.55 – 64)</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.bhaktivedantacollege.org/bvc_site/resources_services/articles/pdfs/jyotish/informal/english/govinda_bhattatiri.pdf|title=Life of Govinda BhattatiriJyothish Sastri|last=Shyamasundara Dasa|publisher=Bhaktivedanta College|access-date=21 April 2010}}</ref>

== Works ==
Govinda wrote ''Nauka'', a commentary on ''Brihat Jataka''. Earlier scholars also assigned to him the authorship of ''[[Daśādhyāyī]]'', another commentary on ''Brihat Jataka'' written with same narrative style.<ref>{{cite book|title=Ahorathra Daśādhyāyī|author=Parameswaran|year=1989|publisher=Prabhat Books|page=12}}</ref> Recent research suggests that ''Nauka'' was the original commentary written by Govinda and ''Daśādhyāyī'' was an abridged version rearranged by another person in the 15th century.<ref>{{cite book|title=History of Kerala Astrology|author=Ayyanath|year=1989|publisher=Prabhat Books|page=12 }}</ref> The authorship of the ''Daśādhyāyī'' was assigned to Govinda Bhattathiri in the ''Ithihyamala'' written by Sankunni during late 19th century.<ref>{{cite book|title=History of caste formation in kerala|author=Savithri M R|year=1989|publisher=Prabhat Books|page=12}}</ref> ''Daśādhyāyī'' is considered to be the most important of the 70 known commentaries on this text.<ref name="Joseph"/>

Govinda wrote another important work in astrology titled ''Muhūrttaratnaṃ''. [[Paramesvara]] (ca.1380–1460), an astronomer of the Kerala school of astronomy and mathematics known for the introduction of the ''Dṛggaṇita'' system of astronomical computations, composed an extensive commentary on this work. In this commentary Paramesvara had indicated that he was a grandson of a disciple of the author of ''Muhūrttaratnaṃ''.<ref>{{cite book|last=Govonda Bhattathiri|title=Muhurtha Rathnam (Sri Parameshwarakritha Vyakhyopetham)|editor=A. Sripada Bhat|publisher=Varahamihira Publications|location=Tirupati, India|date=1999|url=https://www.scribd.com/doc/24158811/Muhurtha-Rathnam-By-Govinda-Bhattathiri}}</ref>
